description: First step for any trip question. Finds Platinumride private transfer routes when the user names cities, countries, airports (e.g. DXB, RUH) or Arabic city names. Full sentences and common typos are fine. Returns matching routes with summary info: slug, travel time, distance, border crossings, indicative per-vehicle 'from' prices and booking links. For full price tiers, border steps and timing of one route, call get_route_details with a returned slug. Call create_inquiry once the customer wants to book. If nothing matches, the route list is empty and suggestions are returned. Then try another city spelling or ask the customer.

from.description: Origin city, airport code or Arabic name, e.g. 'Dubai', 'DXB', 'دبي'.

internationalOnly.description: Optional. true returns only routes that cross a border. Omit for all routes.

limit.description: Maximum number of results, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

q.description: Free-text origin and destination query, a full sentence is fine, e.g. 'Dubai to Muscat with kids', 'Dubai airport to Oman' or 'دبي إلى الرياض'.

to.description: Destination city, airport code or Arabic name, e.g. 'Muscat', 'MCT'.

name: search_routes
title: Search transfer routes
